# Timeline

Displays ordered events with composed time, title, and description primitives.

- **Import:** `import { Timeline, TimelineDescription, TimelineItem, TimelineTime, TimelineTitle } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Data Display
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/data-display-timeline--docs>

## Example

From its `Detailed` story.

```tsx
import {
  ThemeProvider,
  Timeline,
  TimelineDescription,
  TimelineItem,
  TimelineTime,
  TimelineTitle,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

const events = [
  {
    time: "09:00",
    title: "Created",
    description: "Initial event captured.",
  },
  {
    time: "10:30",
    title: "Reviewed",
    description: "Status changed by the team.",
  },
  {
    time: "Now",
    title: "Published",
    description: "Latest update is ready.",
  },
];

export function TimelineExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Timeline density="default">
        {events.map((event) => (
          <TimelineItem key={event.title}>
            <TimelineTime>{event.time}</TimelineTime>
            <TimelineTitle>{event.title}</TimelineTitle>
            <TimelineDescription>{event.description}</TimelineDescription>
          </TimelineItem>
        ))}
      </Timeline>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Timeline

It forwards its ref to `HTMLOListElement`. Its props are `TimelineProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLOListElement>`.

- `density`: `TimelineDensity`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## TimelineItem

It forwards its ref to `HTMLLIElement`. Its props are `TimelineItemProps`, which is `React.LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## TimelineTime

It forwards its ref to `HTMLTimeElement`. Its props are `React.TimeHTMLAttributes<HTMLTimeElement>`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## TimelineTitle

It forwards its ref to `HTMLHeadingElement`. Its props are `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## TimelineDescription

It forwards its ref to `HTMLParagraphElement`. Its props are `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### TimelineDensity

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

```ts
type TimelineDensity = "default" | "compact";
```
